title: thelypteris palustris subsp. pubescens
intro: Thelypteris palustris subsp. pubescens, commonly known as the Marsh Fern, is a subspecies of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Fern include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions, which can help soothe irritated tissues and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
